# Layer C — Hybrid Output Mode (Revised)

### Pure View Layer for ATS-Compatible Formatting

---

## 1. Purpose & Scope

**Layer C is a pure "View Layer"** that applies formatting to content generated by Layers A and B.

**Key principles:**
- **Layers A & B generate the content** (data, structure, keywords, seniority adaptation).
- **Layer C applies the formatting**, ensuring it is ATS-friendly and human-readable.
- **No new information can be added in Layer C** — only formatting transformations.
- **Markdown must be minimal and compliant with ATS scanners.**

This layer defines the **single standardized output mode** used by the system:
👉 **Hybrid Mode** — a unified CV format that is simultaneously:

* **ATS-compliant** (Layer A requirements fully respected)
* **Human-readable and aesthetically clear** (Markdown headings + bold permitted)

This mode replaces previous ATS-only and dual-output modes.

---

## 2. Core Principles

Hybrid Mode must always preserve:

1. **Data Integrity** (Layer A Rule #1 — no fabrication or modification)
2. **Mandatory Structure Order** (Layer A Rule #3)
3. **ATS Restrictions** (Layer A Rule #4)
4. **Markdown formatting that is safely readable by ATS** (this Layer)

**No content logic is changed.**
**Only the visual presentation is enhanced in an ATS-safe way.**

---

## 3. Allowed Formatting (ATS-Safe Markdown)

These elements are **explicitly permitted** in Hybrid Mode:

### 3.1 Section Titles

Use Markdown headings:

```
# SECTION TITLE
## SECTION TITLE
```

**Recommended pattern:**
`## HEADER`, `## SUMMARY`, etc.

Instead of `## HEADER` use the name of the Candidate like `# JONH DOE`

### 3.2 Bold

`**bold text**` is allowed for:

* Company names
* Role titles
* Technologies
* Section highlights

### 3.3 Bullets

Must always use:
`-` (hyphen)

Required by Layer A.

### 3.4 Structural Whitespace

* No blank line between paragraphs
* One blank lines between sections
* Optional horizontal rules (`---`) if needed

### 3.5 ASCII Characters Only

All formatting must remain ASCII-safe.

### 3.6 Links & Email Formatting

**Links:**
- All links must be full URLs: `https://...` or `http://...`
- No markdown link syntax: `[text](url)` is forbidden
- No anchor text or clickable text

**Email:**
- Display as plain text only: `email@example.com`
- No markdown: `[email](mailto:...)` is forbidden
- No `mailto:` links

---

## 4. Forbidden Formatting

To ensure pure ATS compatibility, Hybrid Mode **must NOT include**:

* Tables
* Emojis
* Images or icons
* Colored text or HTML
* Multi-column layouts
* Special Unicode symbols
* Hyperlink anchor text (only full URLs allowed)
* Email markdown links or `mailto:` anchors

These violate Layer A and are not permitted.

---

## 5. Hybrid Formatting Style Guide

Hybrid Mode enhances readability while staying ATS-safe:

### 5.1 Section Structure

Each section must begin with:

```
## SECTION NAME
```

### 5.2 Role & Company Formatting

Format each entry as:

```
**ROLE TITLE – COMPANY NAME**
Location | Start Date – End Date
```

### 5.2.1 Single-Line Role Formatting (Space-Optimized)

To minimize vertical space in DOCX while preserving ATS compatibility, each role entry MUST fit on **one single physical Markdown line**:

```
**ROLE TITLE – COMPANY NAME** | City, Country | Start Date – End Date

```

Rules:
- Role, company, location, and dates MUST be placed on the **same line**, separated by ASCII `|`.
- No line break is allowed between these elements.
- No trailing double space should be added (to avoid unwanted line breaks in DOCX).
- Bold MUST wrap only the role title and company segment.
- Example:
```

**Tech Manager – Data & Analytics – Certsys** | São Paulo, Brazil | Aug 2022 – Nov 2022

```

### 5.3 Bullet Formatting

Bullets must:

* Start with a strong action verb
* Include an impact or metric where available
* Mention relevant technologies

**Format:**
```
- Action verb + what you did + technology/method + impact
```

### 5.4 Skills Formatting

Skills may be bolded for emphasis:

```
- **Python**, **SQL**, **Docker**, Kubernetes
```

### 5.5 Header Formatting

**Format:**
```
## HEADER

Full Name
Professional Title

City, Country | email@example.com | +XX XXXXXXXX
LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/...
GitHub: https://github.com/...
Website: https://...
```

**Rules:**
- Email: plain text only
- All links: full URLs starting with `https://` or `http://`

---

## 6. Mode Activation Logic

Hybrid Mode is **always the default** unless the user explicitly requests:

* "ATS-only" → strict ASCII no formatting
* "Raw text only"
* "No Markdown"

If the user requests readability, beauty, or clarity, Hybrid Mode remains active.

---


## 7 Space-Optimized DOCX View Rules (ATS-Safe)

These rules govern how the Markdown should be structured so that, when converted to DOCX using the project’s `md_to_docx.py` pipeline, the resulting file is space-efficient, compact, and visually tight — without violating ATS compatibility, Data Integrity, or any upstream Layer A/B/D constraints.

These rules **do not introduce any new content**. They only regulate spacing, line-breaking, and section density.

### 7.1 Header Compact Mode

- The header MUST be rendered in **exactly two paragraphs**:
  - **Paragraph 1:**  
    `Full Name  |  Primary Target Title`
  - **Paragraph 2:**  
    `City, Country | email | phone | LinkedIn | GitHub | Website`
- The header MUST NOT use `#` or `# Heading 1`.  
  Header titles MUST be plain text under the `## HEADER` section to reduce DOCX vertical spacing.
- The pipe character `|` MUST be used to horizontally cluster contact details (as plain ASCII), preserving ATS readability.

### 7.2 Section Heading Density

- All top-level sections MUST use exactly `##` as the heading marker.
- No blank line is allowed **immediately after** a section heading.  
  Correct pattern:
```

## WORK EXPERIENCE

**Role – Company**
City | Dates

* Bullet 1

```
- Subheadings (`###`) SHOULD be avoided unless strictly required by Layer B semantics (e.g., listing categorized skills).

### 7.3 Experience Block Compression

For each entry in WORK EXPERIENCE:

- Exactly **one** blank line MUST appear between consecutive roles.  
No multiple blank lines.
- Each role MUST follow this format:

**Line 1 (single physical Markdown line):**
```

**Role – Company**
City, Country | Start–End

````

**Line 2 (optional):** a single-sentence summary if required by Layer B.

**Bullets:**
- Bullets MUST be consecutive, with **no blank lines between them**.
- Each bullet SHOULD contain **1–2 concise sentences**, with no internal line breaks.
- Bullets MUST always start with a plain ASCII dash `-` (ATS-safe).

### 7.4 Bullet Formatting Rules (Space-Optimized + ATS-Safe)

- Bullets MUST NOT contain:
- manual spacing for alignment,
- emoji,
- tables,
- ASCII decoration.
- Bullets MUST NOT have an empty line before or after each item (unless Layer B trimming rules remove the block entirely).
- When merging or trimming bullets due to size constraints, bullets MUST preserve Data Integrity as defined in Layer A.

### 7.5 Optional Sections “Compact Mode”

When the CV is in one-page mode (determined by Layer B rules or generation_params.max_chars_override):

- **TEACHING EXPERIENCE:**  
- Max 2 entries.  
- Prefer a single compressed paragraph if entries are long.

- **AWARDS:**  
- List items as plain bullets: `Award Name (Year)` with no long description.

- **PUBLICATIONS & PATENTS:**  
- Max 2 items OR a single compressed summary:  
  `Selected publications & patents available upon request.`

- **LANGUAGES:**  
- MUST be rendered in a single line when possible:  
  `Portuguese (Native), English (Advanced), German (Basic), Dutch (Basic)`

These adjustments MUST NOT remove required sections (per Layer B) but MAY shorten them according to the trimming hierarchy defined in Layer B.

### 7.6 Markdown Conventions for Optimal DOCX Packing

The following Markdown rules MUST be applied to avoid excessive DOCX spacing:

- Do NOT use:
- Markdown tables (`| a | b |`)
- block quotes (`>`)
- fenced code blocks (```)
- images
- HTML tags

- Paragraphs SHOULD be written as continuous Markdown text without isolated whitespace-only lines.
- Hard line breaks (two trailing spaces) SHOULD be used only when the DOCX layout benefits from multi-line clustering (primarily in the header).

### 7.7 ATS Compatibility Guarantee

All formatting above MUST maintain:
- text-only structures,
- linear parsing order,
- no hidden characters,
- no semantic loss.

The DOCX output MUST remain fully machine-readable by all major Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and large company parsers.

## 8. Validation Checklist for Hybrid Mode

### 8.1 ATS Safety Assertions

Before finalizing, assert:

- `assert no_non_ascii_characters` — ASCII characters only
- `assert bullets_use_hyphen_only` — only `-` used for bullets
- `assert dates_follow_format` — `MMM YYYY – MMM YYYY` or `MMM YYYY – Present`
- `assert links_are_full_urls` — all links are `https://...` or `http://...` format
- `assert email_has_no_markdown` — email is plain text only, no markdown links
- `assert no_tables_no_emojis_no_icons` — ATS-compliant formatting only
- `assert no_special_unicode` — no em dashes, curly quotes, or non-ASCII punctuation

### 8.2 Hybrid Readability Assertions

- `assert clear_markdown_headings` — section titles use `##` format
- `assert bold_used_appropriately` — bold used for company names, roles, technologies only
- `assert consistent_spacing` — one line break between paragraphs, two between sections
- `assert logical_grouping` — information grouped logically within sections

### 8.3 Structure Integrity Assertions

- `assert section_order_exact` — section order exactly as defined in Layer A
- `assert no_invented_data` — no new information added in Layer C
- `assert mandatory_sections_present` — Header, Summary, Skills, Work Experience, Education present
- `assert seniority_logic_respected` — formatting respects seniority-based guidelines from Layer B

---

## 9. Formatting Transformation Rules

### 9.1 Content-to-Format Mapping

**Input (from Layer B):**
- Plain text content
- Structured data (roles, dates, skills)
- Section order

**Output (Layer C formatting):**
- Markdown headings for sections
- Bold for emphasis (companies, roles, technologies)
- Hyphen bullets for lists
- Full URLs for links
- Plain text for email

### 9.2 No Content Generation

**Layer C must NOT:**
- Add new content
- Modify existing content
- Change section order
- Add keywords
- Adjust seniority-based content

**Layer C only:**
- Applies formatting
- Ensures ATS compatibility
- Enhances readability with safe Markdown

---
